values.note: The lodge prices each site type by date ('Best Available Rate'). Tuesday 12 January 2027: $45 for a 40-ft power-and-water site, $50 for a 30-ft one, $55 with full hookups. June 2027: $50 for a 30-ft power-and-water or a full-hookup site, $60 for a 40-ft power-and-water site on a Tuesday and $66 on a Saturday. A Double Buddy site (two campers) is $66-105. Read 2026-10-29. Booked through the lodge's own engine, which takes the first night as a deposit. Vehicles need the $10 ParkPass.

summary: Lodge engine (us01.iqwebbook.com/ULGA340) still books and prices every campsite online. Fees 45-60 -> 45-66 (2027: $45 40-ft P&W in January up to $66 on a June Saturday; Double Buddy $66-105 excluded as a two-rig site); max_rig 30 -> 40 (site names), count 50, no pull-throughs; 50 A/water/sewer confirmed; showers + toilets added, laundry (free) and dump confirmed; season year-round; booking platform operator with engine url, 1-year window; military 25% stated by the lodge itself (discount note replaces the agency's narrower terms). Note cleaned: dropped the wrong 'up to ~30 ft', '~48-51 full-hookup' and the hookup/facility restatements. Not waterfront stands: the loops sit in woods 250+ m east of Unicoi Lake on imagery. Pin within the campground. State park, no price gate.
flags: Booking policy: the entry inherits the state:GA booking row (ReserveAmerica, 13-month window, 4pm cutoff, weekend 2-night / holiday 3-night minimums, 14-night max). That row's own note says the lodge parks incl. Unicoi handle 'their reservations and policies' themselves, and the lodge publishes none of those rules (its FAQ gives a 1-year-before-departure window; the engine's rate types carry minNights 0). Suggest policy_ref 'none' for booking (keeping the $10 ParkPass), as done for 4516 Amicalola Falls, 4529 Georgia Veterans and 4536 Little Ocmulgee.

Website: stored second line https://www.unicoistatepark.org/ is a fan site ('This website is not affiliated with Unicoi State Park or the State of Georgia', (c) 2008-2014, stale $28-53 fees).
